summary: Research record for Semaglutide. Europe PMC indexes 6039 publications, including 305 randomized controlled trials, as of 2026-09-09. Claims are pending human authorship and review.

seo.title: Semaglutide: what the research shows
seo.description: Cited overview of published Semaglutide research: 6039 indexed publications, 305 randomized controlled trials. Evidence tier on every claim.

regulatory_status.value: ChEMBL CHEMBL2108724: maximum clinical phase 4, first approval 2017, ATC A10BJ06. Jurisdiction-level status pending human review.
